title: Why a $1,200 Car Loan Can Cost You Over $10,000 in Interest

scenes.text: A $1,200 car loan could cost you $10,000 in interest.
The average U.S. auto loan is $18,000 with a 7% APR over 60 months, totaling $5,000 interest.
A $1,200 loan at 7% over 36 months yields $260 in interest, but a 60‑month term pushes it to $430.
Most people think the low monthly payment means low cost, but the longer the term the more you pay overall.
